_note: Zero has no separate permissions file: read rules are filters in queries.ts, write rules are server-side checks in mutators.ts (plus src/roles.ts, as in Jazz), so queries and mutators count as data. SQL migrations count as schema; Better Auth's tables come from its own migrations (scripts/db.ts). scripts/ and harness.mjs are bench plumbing; src/scenarios.ts and src/fixtures.ts feed the demo-data route, counted as server as in Jazz.
